MATHEMATICS — MOCK EXAM #13
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x
   B. 12x + 2
   C. 6x + 2
   D. 12x

2. In the number 3543, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 4
   C. 400
   D. 10

3. In the number 3143, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 4
   C. 40
   D. 10

4. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 25

5. Solve for x: x + 3 = 14. (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 14
   C. 3
   D. 11

6. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 82
   B. 9
   C. 18
   D. 81

7. What is √81? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 10
   C. 40.5
   D. 9

8. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 49
   C. 50
   D. 7

   A. 12
   B. 42
   C. 24
   D. 36

10. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 4 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 44
   B. 22
   C. 15
   D. 30

11. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19
   B. 19.6
   C. 19.7
   D. 25

12. What is 8 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 48

   C. 2
   D. 49

   A. 23
   B. 23.6
   C. 23.7
   D. 29

14. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 90
   C. 18
   D. 36

15. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27
   B. 33
   C. 27.6
   D. 27.7

16. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 25
   C. 10
   D. 26

17. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 4 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 38

   C. 30
   D. 60

18. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 11

   D. 122

19. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 13

   D. 26

20. What is 8 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 3
   C. 41
   D. 13

21. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 0.205
   B. 2.5
   C. 0.25
   D. 0.025

22. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 144
   B. 24
   C. 156
   D. 48

23. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. 2/2
   B. 1/4
   C. They are equal
   D. Cannot tell

24. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 3 cm and 4 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 5
   C. 7
   D. 1
